In the lower part of the figure, there are also other categories such as “detritivores” and “primary producers (plants).” Reasoning: The question asks which type of organism the lizard belongs to in this figure. The lizard is located at the trophic level corresponding to the “carnivores” label, so the diagram indicates that the lizard is carnivores.
